---
name: New language SDK
about: Propose an implementation in a language not yet represented
labels: sdk
---

## Language and target

Which language, and who would use it.

## Scope

Decode only, or decode and encode? A decode-only SDK is welcome — the feature matrix
exists to say so honestly.

## Conformance plan

How the runner will be invoked (stdout CLI or in-process), and which variants you expect
to support in the first pass.

## Maintenance

Who maintains it. An SDK with no maintainer is a liability to its users, so this question
is not a formality.
